correctness.rationale: For each positive a,b and even cycle, exact affine-element integration gives a sum of strictly positive weighted |u_i+u_{i+1}|^2 terms equal to 12/(ab) times L2 mass minus derivative energy; equality uniquely forces nodal alternation. Two-node Bloch blocks derive every generalized eigenvalue. Determinant signs make lower and upper roots monotone in cos(theta), fixing both band edges and the contrast ratio; the only double-root endpoint is uniform spacing at theta=pi. A self-contained script passed 1740 finite exact-arithmetic/numerical consistency checks. Finite tests are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The periodic two-length spline grid is a canonical nonuniform test case for inverse stability. The sharp bound is attained on every size and strictly improves the generic minimum-cell estimate for any contrast. The entire two-band classification, exact opening of the central gap and monotone recovery of mesh contrast from a normalized spectral invariant give structurally motivated information beyond a local inequality or isolated finite numerical eigenvalue. Limitations to alternating P1 meshes are explicit.
